newsHighlights.title: Measures set to stabilize finance market
newsHighlights.summary: Chinese authorities unveiled a package of measures designed to stabilize the financial market and anchor market confidence.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国有关部门推出一揽子措施，旨在稳定金融市场、巩固市场信心。

newsHighlights.title: New data group to boost digital economy, AI
newsHighlights.summary: A new national data group has been established to accelerate the digital economy and the development of artificial intelligence.
newsHighlights.translation: 一家新的国家级数据集团正式成立，以加速数字经济发展和人工智能研发。

newsHighlights.title: 'China Haul': Empty suitcases in, packed suitcases out
newsHighlights.summary: Foreign tourists are arriving in China with empty suitcases and leaving with them packed, fueling a consumption boom dubbed the 'China Haul'.
newsHighlights.translation: 外国游客拖着空行李箱来到中国，满载而归，掀起了一场被称为“中国扫货”的消费热潮。

newsHighlights.title: US crackdown on tech counterproductive
newsHighlights.summary: Commentators argue that the US crackdown on technology trade is counterproductive and will ultimately hurt its own businesses.
newsHighlights.translation: 评论认为，美国在科技领域的打压措施适得其反，最终将损害本国企业利益。

newsHighlights.title: Why China's upcoming 5th plenum of 20th CPC Central Committee matters
newsHighlights.summary: The upcoming plenum is set to map out the country's next five-year plan, drawing global attention to its reform and development agenda.
newsHighlights.translation: 即将召开的全会将擘画中国下一个五年规划，其改革与发展议程受到全球关注。

quote.quote: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
quote.author: Peter Drucker
quote.translation: 预测未来最好的方式，就是去创造未来。
quote.explanation: 这句管理学名言强调主动作为的价值。面对金融市场波动和科技竞争，无论是政策制定者还是企业，都需要通过积极的行动和创新来塑造前景，而非被动等待。它与今日新闻中中国推出稳市场措施、布局数字经济的做法高度契合。

vocabulary.example: The new measures are designed to stabilize the financial market.
vocabulary.translation: 新措施旨在稳定金融市场。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 Measures set to stabilize finance market

vocabulary.example: The government rolled out a package of measures to support growth.
vocabulary.translation: 政府推出了一揽子支持增长的措施。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 Measures set to stabilize finance market，指稳市措施

vocabulary.example: The new data group is expected to boost the digital economy and AI.
vocabulary.translation: 新的数据集团有望推动数字经济和人工智能发展。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 New data group to boost digital economy, AI

vocabulary.definition: 打击，镇压，（严厉的）管制措施
vocabulary.example: The US crackdown on tech trade has raised concerns among exporters.
vocabulary.translation: 美国对科技贸易的打压引发了出口企业的担忧。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 US crackdown on tech counterproductive

vocabulary.definition: 适得其反的，产生相反效果的
vocabulary.example: Analysts say the restrictions are counterproductive and will hurt US firms.
vocabulary.translation: 分析人士称这些限制措施适得其反，将损害美国企业。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 US crackdown on tech counterproductive

vocabulary.definition: 一次获得（或偷得）的物品总量；拖，拉
vocabulary.example: Tourists post their 'China haul' online after packing their suitcases.
vocabulary.translation: 游客们在装满行李箱后，在网上晒出自己的“中国扫货战利品”。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 'China Haul': Empty suitcases in, packed suitcases out

vocabulary.example: Rising inbound tourism is driving a new wave of consumption.
vocabulary.translation: 入境游的升温正推动新一轮消费增长。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 'China Haul'，反映境外游客在华消费热潮

vocabulary.example: The data initiative aims to integrate public data resources nationwide.
vocabulary.translation: 该数据倡议旨在整合全国公共数据资源。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 New data group to boost digital economy, AI，指国家级数据布局

vocabulary.example: The plenum will set the country's economic agenda for the next five years.
vocabulary.translation: 全会将确定未来五年国家的经济议程。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 Why China's upcoming 5th plenum matters，指五年规划议程

vocabulary.example: The measures are expected to shore up market confidence.
vocabulary.translation: 这些措施有望提振市场信心。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 Measures set to stabilize finance market，稳定市场预期与信心

pattern.pattern: be set to do sth —— 表示“预计/定于/即将做某事”，常用于新闻标题和正式报道
pattern.example: Measures are set to stabilize the financial market as the upcoming plenum maps out a new five-year plan.
pattern.translation: 随着即将召开的全会擘画新的五年规划，一系列措施预计将稳定金融市场。
pattern.usage: 结构：主语 + be set to + 动词原形。新闻标题中常省略 be 动词（如 Measures set to stabilize...）。可替换 will / is expected to，语气更正式，暗示已有安排或有较强预期。

grammar.title: 新闻标题中的省略现象（Headlinese）
grammar.explanation: 英文新闻标题为了简洁醒目，常省略冠词、系动词 be、助动词等。阅读时需自行补全成分，还原为完整句子。常见规律：① 省略 be 动词；② 用逗号代替 and；③ 用现在时表示已发生的事。
examples: Measures set to stabilize finance market → Measures are set to stabilize the financial market.
'China Haul': Empty suitcases in, packed suitcases out → Tourists come in with empty suitcases and go out with packed suitcases.

pronunciation.tips: 五个音节，重音在倒数第三个音节 -duc- 上。注意前缀 counter- 中的 /aʊ/ 要读饱满，中间的 /tə/ 弱读为轻快的央元音 /ə/，不要读成“康特-”。整体节奏是“轻-轻-重-轻-轻”。
examples: Trade restrictions can be counterproductive in the long run.
Analysts warned that the crackdown is counterproductive.

reading.title: China Rolls Out Measures to Steady Markets and Power the Digital Economy
reading.content: Chinese authorities have announced a package of measures aimed at stabilizing the financial market and supporting steady economic growth. Officials say the steps will strengthen market confidence and guide more capital toward the real economy. At the same time, a new national data group has been set up to accelerate the digital economy and artificial intelligence. The group is expected to integrate public data resources and lower costs for businesses. Meanwhile, the 'China Haul' trend continues to gain steam, as foreign visitors arrive with empty suitcases and leave with them packed with local goods. Analysts say consumption and innovation will be the two engines of the country's next stage of growth. With the upcoming plenum set to map out a new five-year plan, global investors are watching closely for signals on reform, opening-up and the future of the financial market.
reading.translation: 中国有关部门宣布了一揽子措施，旨在稳定金融市场、支持经济平稳增长。官方表示，这些举措将增强市场信心，引导更多资金流向实体经济。与此同时，一家新的国家级数据集团正式成立，以加速数字经济和人工智能发展。该集团预计将整合公共数据资源，降低企业成本。此外，“中国扫货”热潮持续升温，外国游客带着空行李箱来华，满载本地商品而归。分析人士认为，消费和创新将成为中国下一阶段增长的两大引擎。随着即将召开的全会将擘画新的五年规划，全球投资者正密切关注有关改革、开放和金融市场未来的信号。
reading.sourceNote: 本文根据 China Daily《Measures set to stabilize finance market》《New data group to boost digital economy, AI》《'China Haul': Empty suitcases in, packed suitcases out》及 CGTN《Why China's upcoming 5th plenum matters》等今日新闻改写，仅供英语学习使用。
